entry.title: Ukraine: At least 26 killed in Russian strikes on aid center
entry.summary: A Russian strike on an aid station and shelter killed at least 26 people in southern Ukraine on Monday. It was the latest in an unceasing series of Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities and the civilians living there.
